_comment: WHAT MUST NOT REACH master, AND WHY. Each entry is a thing somebody said blocks release.
Written 2026-09-13, after `projection` was merged carrying 183 of 5,346 projections while
'We won't deploy with UTM only' was a standing instruction from before that branch existed.
THAT SENTENCE APPEARED NOWHERE IN THIS REPOSITORY -- it lived in a conversation, and a
conversation is not a place a later session can look. The orchestrator even restated it in a
brief ('a release blocker stated plainly') and merged the branch two hours later anyway.
**A CONSTRAINT THAT EXISTS ONLY IN A TRANSCRIPT DOES NOT EXIST.** When Tom says a thing
blocks release, it is written HERE in the same turn, before any work starts on it. That is
the whole rule, and it is the one the projection failure is made of.
dev/scripts/branch_gate.php refuses a merge of any branch named by an OPEN blocker, so an
unfinished capability cannot burden master even if somebody forgets. Closing one is Tom's
word, recorded in 'closed_by', never an AI's judgement that the work looks sufficient.

blockers.raised: before the projection branch was created
blockers.words: We won't deploy with UTM only.
blockers.restated: Tom, 2026-09-13: 'When are we going to add the full universe of projections? We can't release without it, and I would like to test with it.'
blockers.state: 183 of 5,346 live projected CRS are offered (UTM, a few national grids). dev/projection-catalogue.md has the numbers: the full register is 336 KB raw / 79 KB gzipped as data alone, needs no transform and no proj4js, and is redistributable under the IOGP terms with one attribution line.
